top_signals.title: U.S., China should ‘harbor no illusions’ as they cooperate, compete on AI, Bessent says
top_signals.summary: During Xi's September visit, Washington and Beijing agreed to launch an AI dialogue with a communications channel to help defuse serious incidents.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Cyber response firms ‘nearing capacity’ as attacks grow
top_signals.summary: Top cyber defence consultancies are operating at near “full capacity” after a surge of AI-enabled cyberattacks over the past year, a leading risk advisor has warned. “There’s an interesting dynamic right now in the market where the best incident response shops, […] are all almost full on capacity,” Kroll’s risk advisory president, Brent Tomlinson, told [...]
